availability_audit: Chronology anchor: Route 113 is reached after Mauville/Wattson (cap 30) via Route 111 -> Route 112 -> Fiery Path, per Game Book C20/C21. Every member below is in work/reference-pools/pool-36.json with gate <= 36 and a source_detail map the player has already passed on the way to Route 113: Seaspray Cave B1F (Sneasel), Rusturf Tunnel (Drilbur), Petalburg City Old Rod (Magikarp), Route 102 (Togepi), Mauville Game Corner (Litten), Granite Cave 1F (Abra). No Route 118+, Mt. Pyre, desert-interior or post-Flannery sources are used. Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly (C13); Gyaradosite stone window 20. Adds Petalburg Woods (Heracross gate 14 with Heracronite stone window 14, Kartana gate 20), both on the C05 main path to Rustboro and far behind Route 113.
plan: Sophie is a woodland hazard/redirection team: Forretress lays Spikes behind a Red Card, Parasect at offset +4 is the highest-level member and carries Spore, Rage Powder and Wide Guard on a Focus Sash, and Delphox is the special lane. The crack names Fire pressure, denying redirection through relevant immunities, and chip breaking Focus Sash. Kartana is the answer to the redirection half: as a Grass type it is flatly immune to both Spore and Rage Powder, so Parasect's two best turns do nothing to it. Incineroar is the answer to the hazard half: Flare Blitz is 4x into Bug/Steel Forretress and 4x into Bug/Grass Parasect, and Fake Out can deny the first Spore. Excadrill is immune to Forretress's Volt Switch and Weavile's Knock Off strips the Red Card and the Coba Berry. Deliberately no Grass move on the party - Sawsbuck's Sap Sipper would turn one into a free +1 Attack.
